{{Quote|You shouldn't make speeches like that. It's unpatriotic.''"<br />"''The only thing I find unpatriotic is your warmongering.|Senator Deechi and Senator Amidala, conversing during debates over war funding|<ref name="Senate Murders" />}}
'''Mee Deechi''' was an [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Deechi hailed from the shadowy Umbaran [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] and served the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] as its [[Senator/Legends|delegate]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Deechi became a strong advocate for the funding and enhancement of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and a staunch critic of his anti-war colleagues. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Umbaran joined with the pro-war [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] to campaign for a [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|bill]] that would authorize an order for 5,000,000 more [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to join the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]]. The two were opposed by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and his anti-war coalition, but Deechi and his allies ultimately prevailed, winning the required number of delegate votes to approve the order.

In the immediate aftermath of the vote, Organa's ally, [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], drafted and proposed a piece of [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|counter-legislation]] designed to drastically reduce the Republic's military budget and halt the production of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. Deechi was recognized as an opposition leader during the debates over the budget-reducing legislation, and worked closely with Burtoni to defeat Farr, Organa, and their allies, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]]. Purs, bitter over Farr's past misdeeds, [[Death/Legends|murdered]] her Rodian colleague shortly before the vote on the bill, but escaped notice for a number of [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. Several members of the legislation's support bloc suspected foul play on Deechi's part due to the political strife between the two, but the Umbaran only held occupational ill will toward the late Senator. When Purs came to suspect that Deechi had information on her involvement in the crime, she ambushed him in his [[Deechi's office/Legends|Senate office]] and fatally stabbed him in the chest.

==Biography==
===Political prosperity===
{{Dialogue|Amedda|Let us now vote on Senator Burtoni's bill to fund five million additional clones.|Mothma|The opposition to this bill ''must'' be allowed to speak first!|Deechi|Unfortunately, Senator Organa is nowhere to be found.|attr=Vice Chair Mas Amedda and Senators Mon Mothma and Mee Deechi|src=<ref name="Pursuit">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>}}
Mee Deechi was an [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the final [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] before the [[New Order/Legends|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He hailed from his [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]],<ref name="ep guide 1&2" /> where he lived as a member of one of the top ten social castes<ref name="top ten">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' states that only Umbarans in the top ten social castes were permitted to leave the planet. Deechi's presence on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during "[[Pursuit of Peace]]" and "[[Senate Murders]]" indicates that he was a member of one of these high castes.</ref>&mdash;a high role, given that Umbaran society was comprised of nearly one hundred castes.<ref name="aliens">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Because of his standing,<ref name="top ten" /> Deechi was permitted to pursue a career in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Politics/Legends|politics]]. He ultimately gained a position as the [[Senator/Legends|representative]] of his species and his homeworld in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Umbara Enc">{{SWE|locations|umbara|Umbara}}</ref> Deechi held the office of senator of Umbara while the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] raged, during which [[Time/Legends|time]] he worked out of his [[Deechi's office/Legends|office]] in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the conflict, the Umbaran became a staunch pro-war advocate and supporter of the newly-created [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]<ref name="Senate Murders" />&mdash;positions that made him a close ally of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] Senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]], who held similar views on governance and military action.<ref name="Char Enc">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Conversely, Deechi's militarist rhetoric repeatedly brought him into conflict with [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia's]] senator, [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], who reversed his previously&ndash;pro-war positions after his world was [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|nearly claimed]] by the Confederates earlier in the conflict.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

[[File:Deechi_speaks.png|thumb|left|280px|Mee Deechi worked in the Senate to continue the war and strengthen the Republic military.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 7: Katuunko" /> Deechi and his colleagues were embroiled in discussions over [[Troop/Legends|troop]] surges and the adverse financial strain that waging a pan-[[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war had on the [[Galactic economy|Republic's economy]]. In response to the rising economic fears, the opportunistic Senator [[Gume Saam/Legends|Gume Saam]]<ref name="Heroes">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> of [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]]<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> proposed a [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|bill]] that would allow for the Republic to open new lines of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] to fund the surges, while simultaneously deregulating the banking industry as a whole. After the issue was postponed several times, it was finally brought to a vote, but only after the anti-war Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] announced that the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] was [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|suing for peace]]. Amidala's attempt to use the peace initiative to derail the financial reform bill nearly succeeded, as many senators were prepared to agree that the potential for peace negated the necessity for further war spending. However, just as voting commenced, Confederate [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]] broke into a [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|Coruscant power generator]] control room and [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|detonated]], causing explosions throughout [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] and a [[Coruscant mandatory blackouts/Legends|massive blackout]] that shut down the power in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] itself. The attack incited outrage from Deechi's fellow senators, who approved the deregulation of the banks and the continued funding of the war.<ref name="Heroes" />

The morning after the attack, the Senate reconvened to discuss the Republic's response to the bombing of the [[Power generator/Legends|generator]] and the Separatist peace initiative. With the exception of Amidala and several of her allies, nearly every delegate argued against the accord and instead demanded that the Senate use their new lines of credit to fund an expansion of the military. Halle Burtoni proposed an [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|emergency appropriations bill]] that would use loans from the Banking Clan to purchase 5,000,000 additional [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]<ref name="Pursuit" /> from her homeworld of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="Halle Burtoni">{{SWE|characters|halleburtoni|Halle Burtoni}}</ref>&mdash;a measure that Deechi strongly supported.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> When Amidala tried to reassert that there were indeed members of the Confederacy who were still interested in peace, the Umbaran took his [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpod]] onto the Senate floor and interrupted her, suggesting before the entire [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] that the Senator from Naboo might have [[Republic Senate non-communication law/Legends|treasonous]] relationships with Separatist agents. The tactic worked, and the debate devolved into a shouting match between senators who were lambasting Amidala as a traitor and the few who supported her. Although [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] attempted to calm the legislators, he was cut off by an incoming transmission from the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who informed the Senate that, in light of an alleged [[Attack on Confederate people/Legends|Republic attack]] on a [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Separatist senator]], the peace initiative was off the table.<ref name="Pursuit" />

In the fight to support Burtoni's bill, Deechi was joined by Senators [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]]<ref name="Pursuit" /><ref name="PoP guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode311.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> of [[Roona/Legends|Roona]]<ref name="Edcel">{{DB|character|edcelbargane|Bar Gane, Edcel}}</ref> and [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]]<ref name="Pursuit" /> of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]],<ref name="OrnFreeTaa">{{SWE|characters|ornfreetaa|Orn Free Taa}}</ref> as well as [[Tarnab/Legends|Tarnab]] Senator [[Mot-Not Rab/Legends|Mot-Not Rab]], [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] Senator [[Christo/Legends|Christo]], and [[Human/Legends|Human]] Senator [[Zinn Paulness/Legends|Zinn Pauless]]. The motion's popularity was also bolstered by attacks on opposition delegates carried out by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] under the employ of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tyranus and Darth Sidious<ref name="Pursuit" />&mdash;the alter egos of Count Dooku and Chancellor Palpatine, respectively<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>&mdash;both of whom wished to see the war continue. Although it appeared that the support bloc was going to win outright,<ref name="Pursuit" /> Senate [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]]<ref name="VD" /> [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] agreed to allow opposition leader [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]<ref name="Pursuit" /> of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="VD" /> time to speak before the full congressional assembly prior to the final vote. On the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the vote, the Senate convened in anticipation of the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian's]] presentation, but Organa did not arrive&mdash;instead, he was being rushed to a [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] after nearly being killed in an attack from a [[Robonino/Legends|pair]] [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|of]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters. Deechi was unaware of his colleague's predicament, and as such, requested that Amedda supersede his previous decision and allow the Senate to vote on the bill without hearing the opposition arguments. The Vice Chair resisted for a time, but eventually acquiesced after Deechi silenced<ref name="Pursuit" /> [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrillan]]<ref name="VD" /> Senator [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] calls for Organa to be given more time. Just as they were about to begin, Senator Amidala took the floor, speaking in Organa's place. The anti-war advocate made an impassioned call for peace,<ref name="Pursuit" /> and the Senate was sympathetic to her plea<ref name="UK comic">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.20|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.20]]</ref>&mdash;even Deechi and Burtoni felt the need to applaud her effort. Despite Amidala's efforts and the support that her speech garnered,<ref name="Pursuit" /> the bill passed, and the order for 5,000,000 [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] was placed.<ref name="Chee Twitter Spending Bill">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/10941008766308352|[[Leland Chee]]|date=2010-12-03|quote=For those left wondering, we learned in Season 2 Senate Murders that the military spending increase passed anyway.|nolive=1}}</ref>

===Intrigue, investigations, and assassinations===
{{Quote|Ono had a secret meeting at the docks under the derrick major the night before he died.''"<br />"''And you just happen to know about this meeting how?''"<br />"''Oh, I was having Ono followed. Just because I respected Ono, doesn't mean I wasn't trying to get dirt on him.''"<br />"''Of course.''"<br />"''The point is, a clandestine, off-the-books meeting under the cover of darkness&hellip; perhaps that location holds some clue.|Deechi and Organa discuss Farr's death|<ref name="Senate Murders" />}}
Although Burtoni's legislation was approved, Amidala and her allies chose not to surrender in their fight for a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] end to the war. To that end, she and Onaconda Farr drafted a piece of [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|counter-legislation]] that would negate the troop increase by slashing the Republic's defense budget. Deechi considered the effort to be unpatriotic, and so led the opposition to the bill; in this battle, he stood opposite his political rival, Farr. Although the Umbaran Senator had public opinion on his side, he wanted to ensure that he would be able to use any weapon possible against Farr's coalition. As such, he arranged to have the Rodian followed so he could gather information on any of his opponent's inappropriate dealings or politically damaging activities. Deechi's pursuit did eventually yield results, and it was revealed to the Umbaran that Farr had secretly traveled to the [[Docks under the derrick major/Legends|docks under the derrick major]] on Coruscant to meet with an unknown contact.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

[[File:Deechi_and_Amidala.png|thumb|right|280px|Deechi confronts Amidala after the latter's speech on military spending.]]
The following day, Deechi attended a session of congress wherein Amidala spoke before the Grand Convocation Chamber on the benefits of a reduced military budget and the dangers of further warfare. As the Naboo congresswoman finished her presentation and exited her repulsorpod platform, Deechi met her in the Senate Rotunda's hallway and spoke with her about the bill. The Umbaran asserted that views like those she had expressed in her speech were dangerous and counter to the best interests of the Republic. In response, Amidala accused Deechi of warmongering before leaving to celebrate with her allies. During that celebration of Amidala's well-received speech, Farr collapsed and [[Death/Legends|died]], the apparent victim of [[Heart/Legends|heart]] failure. Deechi later attended his old rival's [[Funeral of Onaconda Farr/Legends|funeral services]] on a Coruscant landing pad, where the Rodian was eulogized by his friend and [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Silood/Legends|Silood]] before the body was transported back to Farr's homeworld of Rodia for final [[Burial/Legends|burial]].<ref name="Senate Murders" />

After the services, Deechi met with Burtoni in his office to enjoy a bottle of [[Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac/Legends|Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac]] [[Wine/Legends|wine]]. The two were interrupted by Senators Organa and Amidala, who had recently learned that Farr's death was the result of [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]]. The two anti-war senators suspected that either Deechi or Burtoni might have had a hand in the crime, as Farr was one of their strongest political opponents. Both the Umbaran and Kaminoan scoffed at the idea&mdash;Deechi respected Farr as a worthy adversary, while Burtoni recognized that the Rodian's anti-war rhetoric was useful for the purposes of raising funds for her propositions. Before Amidala and Organa left his office, Deechi provided them with the information on Farr's clandestine meeting at the docks under the [[Derrick major/Legends|derrick major]] the evening before his death. The two left to investigate that location for clues, leaving Deechi in his office. That night, the Umbaran was confronted by Rodian Senator [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]]&mdash;an aide, pupil, and successor of the late Onaconda Farr.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> Purs, previously an [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representative]],<ref name="New Battlefronts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> had come to resent Farr for his decision to bring the Confederacy to her homeworld of Rodia earlier in the war, and so sought to remove him from office by murdering him. Although she initially escaped suspicion, she eventually learned that Deechi was aware of Farr's meeting at the docks, which Purs had arranged in the hope of intimidating her mentor out of the Senate. Intending to prevent the Umbaran from ever revealing her guilt, Purs stabbed Deechi in the chest with a [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]], killing him.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

The Umbaran Senator's body was discovered by Amidala and Organa upon their return from the docks. Purs' manipulations initially led the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Inspector/Legends|inspector]] [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]] to believe that Burtoni was the culprit, but later revelations brought the Rodian's crimes to light. Purs was arrested for the murder of both Deechi and Farr, and in the days following the upheaval, the bill to reduce the Republic's military spending was defeated in the Senate.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> After Deechi's death, his homeworld of Umbara withdrew its support for the Republic, choosing to secede and ally with the Confederacy of Independent Systems.<ref name="Umbara Enc" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|That was quite a moment, my dear.''"<br />"''Thank you, Senator Deechi.''"<br />"''Oh, it wasn't a compliment.|Senators Deechi and Padmé Amidala, after the latter gives a speech supporting the discontinuation of clone trooper production|<ref name="Senate Murders" />}}
[[File:Deechi_dead.png|thumb|left|250px|Senator Deechi is discovered dead in his office.]]
Mee Deechi was cold and methodical<ref name="SM new guide" /><ref name="SM old guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode215.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Senate Murders}}</ref>&mdash;as was common for his species<ref name="aliens" />&mdash;but was also possessed of a passion for nationalistic pursuits. He proclaimed himself to greatly value the importance of patriotism, although his opponents in the Senate perceived this to be a front for his intent to profit from the pan-galactic Clone Wars.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> As the senator for Umbara and a fierce supporter of the war,<ref name="New Battlefronts" /> Deechi took up the flag of militarism and supported several pieces of legislation that would help to either expand the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] of the Republic or continue the war with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. These positions helped the Umbaran to foster a close working relationship with Senator Halle Burtoni, who held an influential position as the representative from the clone trooper homeworld of Kamino.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

Unlike Burtoni, who loathed her political adversaries, Mee Deechi respected opponents, but enjoyed intimidating them through ruthless political games, such as those he played with Onaconda Farr.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> This predisposition was very much a part of Umbaran culture, in which social advancement was dependent on deception, [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], and subterfuge.<ref name="aliens" /> Deechi was also a talented political opportunist, able to turn many of his colleagues against Senator Padmé Amidala during the debate over the Confederate peace initiative by suggesting that her insistence on peace was rooted in her friendships with enemy leaders. Later, during the debate over Burtoni's clone trooper appropriations bill, the Umbaran and Kaminoan worked in tandem to block the opposition from speaking against the legislation. Although they were ultimately unable to prevent Amidala's rousing speech, both of the war hawks offered cordial, albeit reluctant, applause for the Naboo Senator.<ref name="Pursuit" />

Deechi wore his [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] combed back and possessed pale white skin, broken by his gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and gray facial markings around his eye sockets. During his time in the Senate, he wore an angular gray chestplate and collar over a charcoal-colored jumpsuit, an outfit known as an [[Umbaran silk tunic]].<ref name="New Battlefronts" /> Deechi spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] with a heavy accent, and like several of his fellow senators, he enjoyed Domaine de la Maison sur la Lac wine. Deechi was also notably sarcastic, much to the chagrin of Amidala during the events surrounding Farr's death.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mee Deechi was first introduced in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in "[[Senate Murders]]," the fifteenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The show aired on [[March 19]] of [[2010]] and featured Deechi's death.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> The character returned to the series for the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode "[[Pursuit of Peace]]," which aired on [[December 3]] of [[2010]].<ref name="Pursuit" /> In both episodes, Deechi is voiced by [[Gideon Emery]].<ref name="Senate Murders" /><ref name="Pursuit" />

A deleted scene from "Pursuit of Peace" has Deechi threatening Amidala, attempting to pressure her into voting for the military appropriations bill on the basis of the fact that the bill would open a trade route near Naboo. Deechi further tries to intimidate Amidala by stating that if she votes against the bill, her people would see that she does not have their best interests in mind.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Archives">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]], "Jedi Temple Archives" Blu-ray feature for "[[Pursuit of Peace]]"</ref>
